summary: SiteDocument represents a basic data structure for linking a document to a site in the system. It is used primarily for storing and retrieving documents related to a specific site.
purpose: Facilitates the association of documents with site entities for organizational and retrieval purposes.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page that displays welcome and status information for staff administrators. It includes functionality for viewing last login, handling errors and warnings, and displaying employment applications with filtering and validation controls.
purpose: To provide a dashboard for staff administrators, enabling them to view employment applications, filter by site/discipline/dates, and see login/status information.

workflows.name: View and Filter Employment Applications
steps: Page displays last login, error and warning panels.
StaffAdmin filters applications by site, discipline, date range, or withdrawn status.
Validation and calendar controls assist with date selection.
Employment applications are displayed in a grid, with links for viewing details and sending emails.

business_rules: Employment applications can be filtered by site, discipline, start/end date, and withdrawal status.
WithdrawnDate and status are shown only if the application is withdrawn.
validations: StartDate and EndDate must be valid dates.
StartDate must not be after EndDate (client-side validation).
Required field validators ensure dates are entered.
conditions: Show pnlLastLogin only if LastLogin is available.
Withdrawn applications shown only if chkShowWithdrawn is checked.
system_behavior: RefreshData binds the filtered application list to the grid.
Client-side JavaScript manages field variables and validation.
dependencies: Uses Site and Discipline lists for filtering.
exceptions: Error and warning panels display messages for system exceptions.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity representing a service code used for categorizing and describing various services or options related to courses and timetables within the system.
purpose: Enables categorization and description of services for courses and timetables, with localization support.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Category identifier for the service code

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Localize Name using alt-language if required.

workflows.name: Retrieve ASM Options by Course
steps: System executes ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with CourseID parameter.
Populates ServiceCode list for ASM options.

workflows.name: Retrieve ASM Options by Timetable
steps: System executes ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with TimetableID parameter.
Populates ServiceCode list for ASM options.

business_rules: Localization uses NameAlt when alt language is enabled.
conditions: If alt language is enabled, localized names are used.
system_behavior: ServiceCode retrievals are executed via stored procedures and populate collections.
dependencies: Depends on HSPnetSession for language settings and database procedures.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records changes and actions performed on site profiles, including who performed the action, what was changed, and when the change occurred.
purpose: To audit and track modifications to site profiles, ensuring accountability and traceability.

workflows.name: Audit Site Profile Change
steps: User or SysAdmin makes a change to site profile.
System records action date, user information, action details, and affected fields.
System formats name details and phone for display.

business_rules: If user is not sysadmin and acting as another user, support team is indicated in audit details.
conditions: Display formatted name and details based on user role and impersonation.
system_behavior: Formats audit details for clear display.
dependencies: Depends on DateFormatter, NameFormatter, Phone utilities.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents files presented in an email popup, allowing selection and deletion of files displayed to the user.
purpose: Enables users to select, display, and delete file attachments associated with email popups.

workflows.name: Search and Display EmailPopupDocument
steps: System parses DataInfo, populates list of EmailPopupDocuments.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: User requests deletion of email attachment.
System deletes file from path, removes from display list.

business_rules: Only valid file paths are considered for deletion.
Associated folder is deleted if file deletion succeeds.
conditions: Delete is conditional on valid DataInfo and ID.
system_behavior: Search populates list based on parsed DataInfo.
Delete removes file and folder, updates list.
dependencies: Depends on System.IO for file operations.
exceptions: File or folder deletion exceptions are silently caught.
